FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0

FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS x ON x.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
  AND x.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
  AND x.NumGE1500 = (
      SELECT MAX(x2.NumGE1500)

      JOIN satscores AS x2 ON x2.cds = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
        AND x2.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT sc.School, sc.District, sc.County, sa.AvgScrWrite
  FROM schools AS sc
  JOIN satscores AS sa ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
  WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Closed'
    AND sc.School IS NOT NULL
    AND sa.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
runner_up AS (
  SELECT MAX(AvgScrWrite) AS score
  FROM eligible
  WHERE AvgScrWrite < (SELECT MAX(AvgScrWrite) FROM eligible)
)
SELECT e.School, e.District, e.County, e.AvgScrWrite
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN runner_up AS r ON e.AvgScrWrite = r.score
ORDER BY e.School;

WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`County Name` AS county_name,
        f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter,
        ROUND(
            f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
            2
        ) AS free_meal_percentage,
        ROUND(
            f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
            2
        ) AS frpm_percentage
    FROM frpm AS f
    WHERE f.`County Name` = (
        SELECT County
        FROM schools
        WHERE CDSCode = '01612590125716'
    )
      AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
      AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
)
SELECT
    e.county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(e.free_meal_percentage), 2) AS avg_free_meal_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG(e.frpm_percentage), 2) AS avg_frpm_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN s.cds IS NOT NULL
                THEN s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite
            END
        ),
        2
    ) AS avg_sat_score
FROM eligible_schools AS e
LEFT JOIN satscores AS s
    ON s.cds = e.CDSCode
GROUP BY e.county_name;

SELECT s.School AS name,
       s.County AS county,
       s.District AS district,
       s.City AS city,
       f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS k12_enrollment,
       f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS k12_frpm_eligible,
       f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS k12_frpm_eligible_percentage,
       t.NumTstTakr AS sat_test_takers,

ranked AS (

selected AS (

       COUNT(DISTINCT f.CDSCode) AS qualifying_schools

JOIN satscores AS s

WITH relevant AS (
    SELECT
        c.uuid,
        c.type AS english_card_type,
        fd.name AS japanese_card_name
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN foreign_data AS fd
        ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
      AND fd.language = 'Japanese'
),
ruling_totals AS (
    SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS ruling_total
    FROM rulings
    GROUP BY uuid
)
SELECT
    r.japanese_card_name,
    r.english_card_type,
    SUM(COALESCE(rt.ruling_total, 0)) AS ruling_total
FROM relevant AS r
LEFT JOIN ruling_totals AS rt
    ON rt.uuid = r.uuid
GROUP BY r.japanese_card_name, r.english_card_type
ORDER BY r.japanese_card_name, r.english_card_type;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE CAST(power AS REAL) > 3
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) <= 10;

HAVING COUNT(*) = (

JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = ph.PostId

GROUP BY ph.UserId, p.Id

WITH post_categories AS (
    SELECT
        p.Id,
        p.Score,
        CASE
            WHEN u.Id IS NOT NULL AND lower(u.Location) LIKE '%germany%' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS germany_last_editor
    FROM posts AS p
    LEFT JOIN users AS u
        ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
),
germany_editors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.Reputation
    FROM posts AS p
    JOIN users AS u
        ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
      AND lower(u.Location) LIKE '%germany%'
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN germany_last_editor = 1 THEN COALESCE(Score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS germany_last_editor_posts_total_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN germany_last_editor = 0 THEN COALESCE(Score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS other_posts_total_score,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM germany_editors) AS germany_last_editors_count,
    (SELECT SUM(Reputation) FROM germany_editors) AS germany_editors_combined_reputation

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.Score), 0) AS total_score
FROM postLinks AS pl
JOIN posts AS target
  ON target.Id = pl.RelatedPostId
JOIN posts AS p
  ON p.Id = pl.PostId
WHERE target.Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%';

WITH california_users AS (
    SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
    FROM users
    WHERE Location LIKE '%California%'
       OR Location = 'CA'
       OR Location LIKE '%, CA'
       OR Location LIKE '%, CA,%'
       OR Location LIKE '%, CA %'
),
max_views AS (
    SELECT MAX(Views) AS Views
    FROM california_users
)
SELECT c.Id, c.DisplayName, c.Views, c.Reputation
FROM california_users AS c
JOIN max_views AS m ON c.Views = m.Views
ORDER BY c.Id;

WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT Id, Title
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title LIKE '%principal component scores%' COLLATE NOCASE
),
counts AS (
    SELECT c.Id, c.Title, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.Id) AS related_post_count
    FROM candidates AS c
    LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl
        ON pl.PostId = c.Id OR pl.RelatedPostId = c.Id
    GROUP BY c.Id, c.Title
)
SELECT Title, related_post_count
FROM counts
WHERE related_post_count = (SELECT MAX(related_post_count) FROM counts);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(Reputation), 2)
FROM users
WHERE Reputation IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    TRIM(Location) = 'India'
    OR LOWER(TRIM(Location)) LIKE '%, india'
    OR LOWER(TRIM(Location)) LIKE '%,india'
  )
  AND Id IN (
    SELECT OwnerUserId
    FROM posts
    WHERE CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
  );

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date >= '201301'
      AND y.Date < '201401'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        CustomerID,
        total_consumption,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Segment
            ORDER BY total_consumption, CustomerID
        ) AS rn
    FROM customer_totals
),
selected AS (
    SELECT Segment, total_consumption
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN total_consumption END) -
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN total_consumption END),
        2
    ) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN total_consumption END) -
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN total_consumption END),
        2
    ) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN total_consumption END) -
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN total_consumption END),
        2
    ) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM selected;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(Consumption), 2) AS average_consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 15621
  AND Date >= '201301'
  AND Date < '201401'
  AND Consumption > 0;

WITH customer_year AS (
  SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Currency, SUM(y.Consumption) AS consumption_2012
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE y.Date >= '201201' AND y.Date < '201301'
  GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Currency
)
SELECT ROUND(
  AVG(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN consumption_2012 END) -
  AVG(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN consumption_2012 END)
)
FROM customer_year
WHERE Currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR');

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height IN (
    (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player),
    (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
)
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(pa.finishing) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control END)
    - AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control END)
        AS mean_ball_control_difference
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye');

SELECT MIN(pa.date) AS first_date
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(crossing)
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  );

WITH ranked_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        volleys,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked_ratings AS r
    ON r.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND p.height > 180
  AND r.volleys > 70;

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT m.id AS match_id, l.country_id, p.player_api_id
    FROM "Match" AS m
    JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
    JOIN Player AS p
      ON p.weight <= 160
     AND p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3,
        m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6,
        m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9,
        m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3,
        m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6,
        m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9,
        m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
     )
),
country_counts AS (
    SELECT country_id, COUNT(*) AS player_match_count
    FROM match_players
    GROUP BY country_id
)
SELECT c.name
FROM country_counts AS cc
JOIN Country AS c ON c.id = cc.country_id
WHERE cc.player_match_count = (
    SELECT MIN(player_match_count)
    FROM country_counts
);

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date(date) = '2013-07-12'
      AND lower(defensive_work_rate) IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
      AND overall_rating IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (
        MAX(CASE WHEN player_api_id = 30700 THEN overall_rating END)
        - AVG(overall_rating)
    ) / AVG(overall_rating),
    2
) AS pct_higher
FROM eligible;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM trans AS t
WHERE t.k_symbol IS NULL
  AND t.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.gender = 'M'
      AND c.birth_date >= '1974-01-01'
      AND c.birth_date < '1977-01-01'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM trans AS t
      WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
        AND t.bank = 'AB'
  );

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A11
  FROM district AS d
  JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  WHERE lower(d.A3) = 'east bohemia'
    AND c.birth_date >= '1980-01-01'
    AND c.birth_date < '1990-01-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS average_salary,
       COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM qualifying_districts;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    JOIN disp AS own
      ON own.client_id = c.client_id
     AND own.type = 'OWNER'
    WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disp AS any_disp
          JOIN card AS ca ON ca.disp_id = any_disp.disp_id
          WHERE any_disp.account_id = own.account_id
      )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_district_salary
FROM qualifying_districts AS q
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = q.district_id;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.trans_id END) AS household_payments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
         AND t.k_symbol <> 'SIPO'
         AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> ''
        THEN t.trans_id
    END) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d
    ON d.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client AS c
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND c.gender = 'M'
  AND c.birth_date >= '1974-01-01'
  AND c.birth_date < '1977-01-01'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.operation = 'PREVOD NA UCET'
  AND t.amount > 4000;

WITH card_district AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.type,
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS p ON p.disp_id = c.disp_id
    JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = p.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id
    WHERE c.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
)
SELECT type, district, inhabitants
FROM card_district AS cd
WHERE inhabitants = (
    SELECT MIN(cd2.inhabitants)
    FROM card_district AS cd2
    WHERE cd2.type = cd.type
)
ORDER BY type, district;

WITH
district_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
        a.account_id
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
),
district_withdrawals AS (
    SELECT
        da.district_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_withdrawn
    FROM district_accounts AS da
    JOIN trans AS t
      ON t.account_id = da.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.operation IN ('VYBER', 'VYBER KARTOU')
    GROUP BY da.district_id
),
district_standing_orders AS (
    SELECT
        da.district_id,
        SUM(o.amount) AS total_standing_order_debit
    FROM district_accounts AS da
    JOIN `order` AS o
      ON o.account_id = da.account_id
    WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
    GROUP BY da.district_id
),
district_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        da.district_id,
        da.district_name,
        da.region,
        da.population,
        dw.total_amount_withdrawn,
        1.0 * dw.total_amount_withdrawn / da.population AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        COALESCE(dso.total_standing_order_debit, 0.0)
            / COUNT(DISTINCT da.account_id) AS average_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM district_accounts AS da
    JOIN district_withdrawals AS dw
      ON dw.district_id = da.district_id
    LEFT JOIN district_standing_orders AS dso
      ON dso.district_id = da.district_id
    GROUP BY
        da.district_id,
        da.district_name,
        da.region,
        da.population,
        dw.total_amount_withdrawn,
        dso.total_standing_order_debit
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_amount_withdrawn,
    ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    ROUND(average_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS average_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM district_metrics
ORDER BY rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant, district_name;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_withdrawn
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
external_counterparties AS (
    SELECT account_id, bank, account
    FROM trans
    WHERE bank IS NOT NULL AND account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY account_id, bank, account
),
counterparty_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_external_counterparties
    FROM external_counterparties
    GROUP BY account_id
),
account_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        ga.account_id,
        district.A2 AS district_name,
        district.A3 AS region,
        COALESCE(tt.total_amount_received, 0) AS total_amount_received,
        COALESCE(tt.total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
        COALESCE(lc.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
        COALESCE(cc.number_of_external_counterparties, 0) AS number_of_external_counterparties
    FROM gold_accounts AS ga
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = ga.account_id
    JOIN district ON district.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN transaction_totals AS tt ON tt.account_id = ga.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_counts AS lc ON lc.account_id = ga.account_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparty_counts AS cc ON cc.account_id = ga.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    district_name,
    region,
    total_amount_received,
    total_amount_withdrawn,
    number_of_loans,
    number_of_external_counterparties,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY number_of_external_counterparties DESC) AS counterparty_rank
FROM account_metrics
ORDER BY counterparty_rank, account_id;

SELECT 'Young cohort' AS cohort, ROUND(AVG(d.A11)) AS average_salary
FROM client c

SELECT 'Old cohort' AS cohort, ROUND(AVG(d.A11)) AS average_salary
FROM client c

JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id

WITH japanese_entries AS (
    SELECT r.resultId, r.raceId, r.laps
    FROM results AS r
    JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
      AND d.nationality = 'Japanese'
),
winners AS (
    SELECT raceId, laps
    FROM results
    WHERE position = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN je.laps = w.laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM japanese_entries AS je
JOIN winners AS w ON w.raceId = je.raceId;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM results AS r
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(r.fastestLapTime) <> ''

       + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
       + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url,
    d.dob,
    COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
    ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1971-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1986-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob, q.q1
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL

      + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1, INSTR(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
      = (
          SELECT MAX(
              CAST(SUBSTR(q2.q1, 1, INSTR(q2.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60.0
              + CAST(SUBSTR(q2.q1, INSTR(q2.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
          )
          FROM races AS r2
          JOIN qualifying AS q2 ON q2.raceId = r2.raceId
          WHERE r2.year = 1995
            AND r2.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
            AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
            AND TRIM(q2.q1) <> ''
      );

SELECT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 = (

      FROM qualifying AS q2
      JOIN races AS r2 ON r2.raceId = q2.raceId
      WHERE r2.year = 1995

  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM qualifying AS di_grassi
JOIN races AS race
  ON race.raceId = di_grassi.raceId
JOIN qualifying AS other
  ON other.raceId = di_grassi.raceId
WHERE race.year = 2010

  AND di_grassi.position IS NOT NULL
  AND other.position IS NOT NULL
  AND di_grassi.position < other.position;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) < 100;

WITH q3_counts AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS q3_lap_count
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q3) <> ''
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(q3_counts.q3_lap_count, 0)), 2) AS average_q3_lap_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN q3_counts
    ON d.driverId = q3_counts.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1981-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1992-01-01';

SELECT d.code, q.q3
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, 1, INSTR(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
       + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
       + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, '.') + 1, 3) AS INTEGER)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.number, d.surname
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND (
        CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
        + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
      ) < 98.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1962
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Withdrew';

SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount END) * 1.0
    / MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount END) AS ratio
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement'
  AND e.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting');

WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        SUM(b.spent) AS total_spending,
        SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget,
        SUM(b.spent) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS spending_to_budget_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
)
SELECT event_id, event_name, total_spending, total_budget, spending_to_budget_ratio
FROM per_event
WHERE spending_to_budget_ratio = (
    SELECT MAX(spending_to_budget_ratio)
    FROM per_event
);

WITH dept_majors AS (
    SELECT department, major_id, major_name
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
major_counts AS (
    SELECT
        dm.department,
        dm.major_id,
        dm.major_name,
        COUNT(m.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM dept_majors AS dm
    LEFT JOIN member AS m
        ON m.link_to_major = dm.major_id
    GROUP BY dm.department, dm.major_id, dm.major_name
)
SELECT
    department,
    GROUP_CONCAT(major_name, ', ') AS majors_offered,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
        CASE WHEN member_count > 0 THEN major_name END,
        ', '
    ) AS majors_held_by_members,
    ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS average_members_per_major
FROM major_counts
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department;

WITH events_2019 AS (
    SELECT event_id, type
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date >= '2019-01-01'
      AND event_date < '2020-01-01'
),
attendance_by_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
budget_by_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS budgeted_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT
    e.type AS event_type,
    SUM(COALESCE(a.member_count, 0)) AS members_attended,
    SUM(COALESCE(b.budgeted_amount, 0)) AS total_budgeted_dollars
FROM events_2019 AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance_by_event AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN budget_by_event AS b
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
GROUP BY e.type
ORDER BY e.type;

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_dues
FROM income AS i
WHERE i.source = 'Dues'
  AND i.link_to_member IN (
      SELECT a.link_to_member
      FROM attendance AS a
      JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
      WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
  );

WITH chip_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event
  FROM expense x
  JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
  WHERE lower(x.expense_description) LIKE '%chips%'
),
event_maxima AS (
  SELECT b.link_to_event, MAX(b.amount) AS largest_line
  FROM budget b
  JOIN chip_events ce ON ce.link_to_event = b.link_to_event
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name
FROM event_maxima m
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = m.link_to_event
WHERE m.largest_line = (SELECT MAX(largest_line) FROM event_maxima)
ORDER BY e.event_name;

WITH RECURSIVE food_records(expense_id, rest) AS (
    SELECT e.expense_id, COALESCE(e.expense_description, '') || ','
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE lower(b.category) = 'food'
),
items(expense_id, item, rest) AS (
    SELECT
        expense_id,
        trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1)),
        substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1)
    FROM food_records
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        expense_id,
        trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1)),
        substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1)
    FROM items
    WHERE rest <> ''
)
SELECT item, COUNT(DISTINCT expense_id) AS record_count
FROM items
WHERE item <> ''
GROUP BY lower(item)
ORDER BY record_count DESC, lower(item) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-'

SELECT AVG(h.height_cm * 1.0) AS avg_height_cm
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND h.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND h.height_cm <> 0
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
      WHERE hp.hero_id = h.id
        AND sp.power_name IS NOT NULL
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM superhero AS dc
            JOIN publisher AS dp ON dp.id = dc.publisher_id
            JOIN hero_power AS dhp ON dhp.hero_id = dc.id
            JOIN superpower AS dsp ON dsp.id = dhp.power_id
            WHERE dp.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
              AND dsp.power_name = sp.power_name
        )
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE a.alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad');

WITH qualifying_heroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, g.gender
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
  JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
  JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
  WHERE c.colour = 'Blue'
    AND g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  GROUP BY s.id, g.gender
  HAVING COUNT(hp.power_id) >= 10
)
SELECT gender.gender, COUNT(qualifying_heroes.id) AS hero_count
FROM gender
LEFT JOIN qualifying_heroes ON qualifying_heroes.gender = gender.gender
WHERE gender.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
GROUP BY gender.gender
ORDER BY gender.gender;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS avg_powers_per_hero
FROM (
  SELECT s.id, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    AND g.gender = 'Male'
  JOIN race r ON r.id = s.race_id
    AND r.race IN ('God', 'Eternal')
  LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
  GROUP BY s.id
);

WITH target_publisher AS (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
),
race_counts AS (
    SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN target_publisher AS tp ON tp.publisher_id = s.publisher_id
    JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
    WHERE r.race IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(r.race) <> ''
      AND r.race <> '-'
    GROUP BY r.race
)
SELECT race, superhero_count
FROM race_counts
WHERE superhero_count = (SELECT MAX(superhero_count) FROM race_counts);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg))
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
      AND sp.power_name = 'Flight'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS different_superpower_count
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = h.gender_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND h.weight_kg < 70
  AND h.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
WHERE s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND s.height_cm <> 0
  AND s.height_cm = (
      SELECT MIN(height_cm)
      FROM superhero
      WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
        AND height_cm <> 0
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-';

WITH elevated AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0)
       OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5)
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN ID END) AS male_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN ID END) AS female_count
    FROM elevated
)
SELECT CAST(male_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(female_count, 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM counts;

SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.GLU >= 180
      AND l.`T-CHO` < 250
);

SELECT p.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
       - CASE
           WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)
           THEN 1 ELSE 0
         END AS completed_age_on_2026_10_09
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID, p.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_female
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday < '1971-10-09'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.PT >= 14
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Description IS NULL
  AND l.CRP = '+';

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        l.Date,
        l.DNA,
        CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) AS level
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
      AND p.Admission = '+'
      AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        Date,
        DNA,
        level,
        MAX(level) OVER (PARTITION BY ID) AS max_level
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT ID, Date, DNA
FROM ranked
WHERE level = max_level
ORDER BY ID, Date;

SELECT MAX(CAST(L.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_rnp
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.RNP GLOB '[0-9]*';

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) > 64 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Examination e
          WHERE e.ID = p.ID
            AND e.Thrombosis > 0
      )
) AS cohort
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = cohort.ID
WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age_years
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.LDH > 600
  AND l.LDH < 800
  AND (
      CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 300
      OR l."U-PRO" IN ('>=300', '>=1000')
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT AVG(HCT)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date >= '1991-01-01'
  AND Date < '1992-01-01'
  AND HCT IS NOT NULL
  AND (CAST(`U-PRO` AS REAL) >= 300 OR `U-PRO` IN ('>=300', '>=1000'));

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.CPK < 250
  AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) > 4
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.LDH >= 500
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND (
          CASE
              WHEN l."U-PRO" = '+2(100)' THEN 100
              WHEN l."U-PRO" LIKE '>=%'
                  THEN CAST(SUBSTR(l."U-PRO", 3) AS REAL)
              WHEN l."U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*'
                   AND l."U-PRO" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
                  THEN CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL)
              WHEN l."U-PRO" LIKE '+%(%'
                  THEN CAST(
                      SUBSTR(
                          l."U-PRO",
                          INSTR(l."U-PRO", '(') + 1,
                          INSTR(l."U-PRO", ')') - INSTR(l."U-PRO", '(') - 1
                      ) AS REAL
                  )
          END
      ) >= 100
)
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND `First Date` >= '1998-01-01'
  AND `First Date` < '1999-01-01'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%';

SELECT e.Symptoms, p.Diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC, p.ID ASC, e.`Examination Date` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS patients_never_abnormal
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.GPT >= 60
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND (l.RBC <= 3.5 OR l.RBC >= 6.0)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT c.bond_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')
   OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p')
GROUP BY c.bond_id
ORDER BY c.bond_id;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
);

WITH molecule_groups AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(b.bond_id) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 0
      THEN 'all_single'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS saturation_group
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
)
SELECT
  saturation_group,
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM molecule_groups
GROUP BY saturation_group
ORDER BY CASE saturation_group WHEN 'all_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN a1.element = 'cl' THEN a2.atom_id
    WHEN a2.element = 'cl' THEN a1.atom_id
END)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl';

WITH rare_elements AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    WHERE element IS NOT NULL
      AND molecule_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY element
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
),
qualifying_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN atom AS a
      ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    JOIN rare_elements AS r
      ON r.element = a.element
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
atom_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT c.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.bond_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.atom_id
)
SELECT qm.molecule_id,
       SUM(COALESCE(abc.bond_count, 0)) AS bond_count
FROM qualifying_molecules AS qm
JOIN atom AS a
  ON a.molecule_id = qm.molecule_id
JOIN rare_elements AS r
  ON r.element = a.element
LEFT JOIN atom_bond_counts AS abc
  ON abc.atom_id = a.atom_id
GROUP BY qm.molecule_id
ORDER BY qm.molecule_id;

WITH tr_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR397'
),
bonds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN tr_atoms AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN tr_atoms AS b ON b.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE c.bond_id IS NOT NULL
),
degrees AS (
    SELECT ta.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bonds.bond_id) AS degree
    FROM tr_atoms AS ta
    LEFT JOIN bonds
        ON ta.atom_id IN (bonds.atom_id, bonds.atom_id2)
    GROUP BY ta.atom_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(degree), 2)
FROM degrees;

WITH selected_bonds AS (
    SELECT
        bond_id,
        bond_type,
        substr(bond_id, 1, instr(bond_id, '_') - 1) AS molecule_id,
        substr(bond_id, instr(bond_id, '_') + 1) AS endpoint_pair
    FROM bond
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
      AND bond_type IN ('-', '=')
),
bond_elements AS (
    SELECT
        b.bond_type,
        m.label,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM selected_bonds b
    JOIN molecule m
      ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a1
      ON a1.atom_id = b.molecule_id || '_' ||
         substr(b.endpoint_pair, 1, instr(b.endpoint_pair, '_') - 1)
    JOIN atom a2
      ON a2.atom_id = b.molecule_id || '_' ||
         substr(b.endpoint_pair, instr(b.endpoint_pair, '_') + 1)
)
SELECT
    bond_type,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN element1 <= element2 THEN element1 || '|' || element2
        ELSE element2 || '|' || element1
    END) AS element_pair_count,
    MAX(label) AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_elements
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_type ASC;
